title: Deep learning-based classification and segmentation of retinal cavitations on optical coherence tomography images of macular telangiectasia type 2.
summary: Two CNNs classified and segmented MacTel2 retinal cavitations, with outputs checked against manual measurements and longitudinal trial data.
